svg.title: Rodin architecture
svg.desc: The central core-module stack runs from Math and Geometry through quadrature, expressions, variational problems, assembly, solvers and IO. Model modules are on the left in green. Third-party integrations and dependencies are on the right in yellow. Shared services, shown in dimmed purple, support the whole library.

g.text: Context · Alert · Utility · Location · Serialization · Test
Execution contexts, diagnostics, generic helpers, spatial search, persistence and numerical testing
